messages.en: What are you doing!!

messages.ko: 마카오 콘서트 잘 마치고 한국 복귀><
messages.en: Finished the Macau concert successfully and returned to Korea ><
Macau always seems to hold a special meaning for me.
Last time, it was my birthday,
and this time, it's Jiwoo unnie's birthday.
It leaves me with so many memories.
I finally got to try a warm egg tart ㅠㅠ
It was so delicious.
I kept eating delicious food,
and even on the concert day, the delicious food kept getting replenished nonstop,
I almost turned into an Odyssey pig.
From the event all the way to the concert,
I think I spent more time in the air than on the ground.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 시그널 정말 재밌더라 공포 방탈출 너무 웃겼어 ㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Signal was really fun! The horror escape room was so funny ㅋㅋㅋ
Right, I watched it too.
I filmed that with Chaeyeon unnie,
and it stuck with me so much afterward
that I kept going around explaining it to the members.
It was fun.
I dragged Chaeyeon unnie along so many times.
Like, it was scary, so why didn't you run away
instead of collapsing right there!!!
But I thought I wasn't scared of that kind of thing.

messages.ko: 그 방울 흔들로 들어간 신당 있잖아
messages.en: You know that shrine we entered after shaking the bell?
When the ghost opened the door and stood there,
that was seriously...
my most genuine, full-volume scream ever.

messages.ko: 실제로 가면 더 어둡고 문제도 어두워서 안보이고
messages.en: In person, it was even darker, and I couldn't see the clues because it was so dark.

messages.ko: 바로앞에 뭐가 있을지 모르겠는 그 무서움이
messages.en: That fear of not knowing what might be right in front of you
was genuinely terrifying…
When people get startled,
they get superhuman strength, you know.
After filming that, we were running around trying to escape,
and I bruised my shoulder while unnie bruised her hip.
We ended up with bruises,
and I don't even know when it happened ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 아니 창귀 연기하신분은 괜찮으시려나 하연이가 엄청 때리던대
messages.en: I wonder if the person playing the changgwi is okay. Hayeon was hitting them so much.
ㅌㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Even after we finished, we kept looking for them.
We asked a staff member,
Where is the changgwi!!!!
Please find them for us! We need to talk to them.
That's what we said,
but that staff member was actually the changgwi.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
And the ending was so chilling.

messages.ko: 산장에 들어가서 우리한테 살아서 나갈 방법을 알려주던
messages.en: The one who told us how to get out alive after we entered the mountain lodge
the safety headquarters on the TV
was actually the changgwi pretending to be the safety headquarters and luring us in.
It had been manipulating us into releasing the changgwi.
Taking the objects, praying, and shaking the bell

messages.ko: 살아서 나갈 방법이 아니라 창귀한테 홀려있던 상태인거라
messages.en: wasn't how we were supposed to get out alive. We were already under the changgwi's spell.
That's why the changgwi appeared no matter where we went at the end:
its seal had been broken, and it killed us.
That was the ending.
Oh, was that a spoiler?
Then pretend you didn't hear any of that~~
ㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Bare-faced Hayeon on the plane.
I took this because I thought I looked pretty bare-faced for once.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹ
All the puffiness went down, right?
I just happened to look especially pretty then,
but I look like a mess now.
We're matching💕
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Did you eat anything after getting back to Korea?
I just ordered something.
But my memory's been getting so short lately,
so I order something and then forget what I ordered,
and when it arrives,
I eat it like I'm opening a random blind box.
What did I order again? What could this be}?

messages.ko: 딱 뜯고 아 맞다 이거지! 맛있겠당
messages.en: Then I open it and go, Oh right, this is what I ordered! Looks yummy.

messages.ko: 일부로 영수증도 안보고 더 기억하지 않으려고 한다음
messages.en: I even deliberately avoid looking at the receipt so I won't remember,
because the big reveal gives me a dopamine rush.
I don't know, lately
maybe because there's so much new data coming into my brain,
I keep forgetting things.
It's driving me crazy ㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 그래서 요즘 스케줄도 막 이리저리 왔다갔다해서
messages.en: And my schedule has been all over the place lately,
so it's hard to keep track of everything one by one.
I just check the pickup time,
and finding out what I'm doing that day is like opening a random blind box.

messages.ko: 아오늘 유튜브 촬영이구나! 아 오늘 인터뷰구나!
messages.en: Oh, I'm filming YouTube content today! Oh, I have an interview today!
That's how I find out.
I really shouldn't be doing this,
but is this the limit of my brain?
Now that we're going on tour,
I should film a bunch of Magical Girl episodes in one go too.
I'm so happy.
I'm grateful to have a schedule.
Hayeon, don't get sick.
I'm not sick.
I'm surprisingly full of energy.
As long as I sleep, I recover from everything.
My food is here.
I wonder what food it is~?
I'm looking forward to it.
What was the food Hayeon was craving just a few minutes ago~?
Ah, suddenly the excitement is gone.
I remembered what it was, so now it's not fun anymore.
Spicy pork stir-fry with broth.
I'll eat it with the kimchi I've been saving up~
Then I'll do my makeup in 30 minutes
and go do a video call.
Okay, all sorted.
ㅋㄹㅋㅅㅋㅅㅋㅅㅋㅅㅋㅅ
I'm off to have a mukbang-level feast.
Baby, I'll do my best!
Y/n, Haranghae ❤️❤️
